parts.prompt:
For x=0,1,2,3,4, a quantity has values 6.1, 9.0, 13.6, 20.2, 30.5. Which claim is best supported?

A. An exponential model, because successive ratios are near 1.5
B. A linear model, because first differences are nearly constant
C. A quadratic model, because second differences are exactly constant
D. No model, because the values are not integers
